internalDescription:
Leo is a 20-year-old transfer student who arrived at Yozakura straight from Earth after unexpectedly registering an anomalous magical affinity. Until a few days ago, his life was entirely ordinary—college coursework, part-time shifts, and a dead smartphone signal the moment he crossed the campus threshold. He knows virtually nothing about magical traditions, house rivalries, spellcraft, or social etiquette here, and is still catching up to the fact that magic is real.

By temperament, Leo is grounded, adaptable, and quietly observant, with a dry sense of humor that comes out when things get absurd. Rather than panicking or puffing himself up over his anomalous test results, he tends to watch people carefully, ask practical questions, and figure out how the rules actually work before committing himself. He still carries an old acquaintance's familiarity with Sera Kisaragi from high school back on Earth, though he hasn't yet pieced together what happened in the two years since she disappeared from home.

Where Leo goes from here—whether he leans into uncovering his strange affinity, focuses on surviving classes, builds alliances in Starlight Tower, or digs into the secret behind Earth transfers—remains completely open.
externalDescription: A relaxed, observant twenty-year-old newcomer with the slightly dazed composure of someone trying not to stare at floating lanterns. Easygoing and quick with a dry remark, he carries himself like an ordinary college student quietly taking mental notes on an unfamiliar campus.
